Container.Name: bose-soundtouch-bridge
Container.Overview: Keeps Bose SoundTouch preset buttons working after the 2026 Bose cloud shutdown. Discovers speakers automatically via SSDP, maps physical preset buttons to your own stream URLs via UPnP, and optionally integrates with Home Assistant via MQTT. No cloud account required.
Container.Description: Keeps Bose SoundTouch preset buttons working after the 2026 Bose cloud shutdown. Discovers speakers automatically via SSDP, maps physical preset buttons to your own stream URLs via UPnP, and optionally integrates with Home Assistant via MQTT. No cloud account required.

Config.Name: Preset 1 URL
Config.Description: Audio stream URL for physical preset button 1 (e.g. http://stream.example.com/radio.mp3). Applied to all discovered SoundTouch speakers unless overridden via SPEAKERS_JSON.

Config.Name: Preset 2 URL
Config.Description: Audio stream URL for physical preset button 2.

Config.Name: Preset 3 URL
Config.Description: Audio stream URL for physical preset button 3.

Config.Name: Preset 4 URL
Config.Description: Audio stream URL for physical preset button 4.

Config.Name: Preset 5 URL
Config.Description: Audio stream URL for physical preset button 5.

Config.Name: Preset 6 URL
Config.Description: Audio stream URL for physical preset button 6.

Config.Name: Speakers JSON
Config.Description: Optional. JSON array for per-speaker preset overrides. Example: [{"name":"SoundTouch 10 Wohnzimmer","preset_1_url":"http://..."}]. Leave empty to apply the same presets to all speakers.

Config.Name: Sync Presets on Startup
Config.Description: Write configured URLs into the speaker's preset slots on startup so physical buttons work immediately. Disable only if you want to manage presets manually.

Config.Name: MQTT Host
Config.Description: Optional. IP or hostname of your MQTT broker (e.g. 192.168.1.10). Required for Home Assistant button integration.
